<!-- review-cost: effort low, no escalation -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

### What looks good

- `LinkError::Busy(String)` has its own exit code. The codes stay unique: 0 stood, 1 refused, 2 usage, 3 no window, 4 busy.
- A hello timeout on a live socket gives `Busy`. A real stale link still gives exit 3. A refused token still gives exit 1. I checked each case.
- `UI_USAGE` names exit 4. `bad_ui_arguments_are_usage_errors` asserts the new line.
- The discovery file check comes before the connect. No link file stays a clean exit 3 with its own message.
- The new code has no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!`. The hello wait is bounded by `HELLO_TIMEOUT` (5 s). There is no busy loop.
- The pin proves the busy case at the CLI level: exit 4 and the text "is busy with another call".
- `docs/decisions/3865-ui-busy-message.md` records the choice.
- The trial merge with main is clean.

### Exit codes (checked by test and by hand)

| Case | Message | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| No link file | "no running CamCraft window: no link file in ... - start camcraft first" | 3 |
| Stale file: socket refuses (ECONNREFUSED) or socket missing (ENOENT) | "no running CamCraft window answered: the link files in ... are stale" | 3 |
| Live window, wrong token | "refused the link token in its link file" | 1 |
| Live window, hello times out | "is busy with another call (nothing ran)" | 4 |

A second `--ui` call does not see the busy window as stale, and a window that does not run does not look busy. The issue asks for a distinct message and a distinct exit code. The PR meets both. The issue names no number for the code.

### Results (locally; trial merge with main 9adabbb84; `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=3`)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge `be6b1fd2c` with main | clean, no conflict |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` | 3 steps, 0 failed. app build ok (230 s); app lib 306 passed; mcp_live 20 passed |
| Pin, exact: `ui_link::a_second_ui_call_during_a_slow_call_reports_busy_and_exits_4` | 1 passed (5.20 s) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test cli` | 13 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean (1 m 25 s) |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps, 0 failed, 14.9 min (rows below) |
| `camcraft-cli --ui call` on a stale Unix socket, a missing socket and an empty folder | exit 3 with the stale or no-window text, in each case |

The exact pin ran as `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live -- --exact ui_link::a_second_ui_call_during_a_slow_call_reports_busy_and_exits_4`. `cargo xtask gate test` refuses a static selection for the conditional `mcp_live` suite.

Light lane rows: `light build` ok (581 s); `motion light: lib` 7 passed; `motion light: adaptive_troch_island` 1 passed; `motion light: adaptive_troch_neck` 1 passed; `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel` 1 passed; `app light: pocket_pass_start` 1 passed.

### Targeted tests

- Example catalog: not run. The PR changes no post and no toolpath.
- Light lane: `cargo xtask gate light`, green (rows above).
- Heavy step: none. The issue is `P3`, so no targeted heavy step is due.

### Laws checked

- Prime Directive: no panic path, no unchecked cast, no silent wrong answer.
- Layering and placement: the change is in `crates/app/src/mcp/link_client.rs` (MCP and the CLI), and the test is in `crates/app/tests/mcp_live/`, which imports `camcraft_app::mcp`. The gate map names `app::mcp::link_client`.
- No new `camcraft-*` dependency, no process file, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no golden change, no snapshot PNG.
- `link_client.rs` is 267 lines. The provenance line is present.
- Commit subject is conventional. The body has `Fixes #3865` and a `Changelog:` line.

### Requested before merge

None. There are no blockers.

### Notes (not blocking)

1. `crates/app/src/mcp/link_client.rs:22-24`: the `HELLO_TIMEOUT` comment says a timeout means "a stale file, a hung window". The code now reads a timeout as `Busy`. Please reword the comment to say the window is busy or hung.
2. `docs/decisions/3865-ui-busy-message.md`: `docs/decisions/README.md` asks for what was considered and dropped, and for the cost to change later. The file has the decision and why, but not those two parts. A short paragraph for each closes the gap.
3. The commit body of `be6b1fd2c` says "500 ms timeout". The code uses 5 s (`link_client.rs:24`). A commit message cannot change without a force-push, so I do not ask for a fix here.
4. When several windows answer and one refuses while another is busy, the refusal wins (`link_client.rs:188-195`). This order reads well and is not a defect.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
